verdict.rationale: x402's core design and marketing explicitly remove approval friction — 'AI agent pays instantly with stablecoins, no signups or approvals required' — and agentic wallets/accounts let an agent hold funds and pay autonomously via signed cryptographic proof of payment, not a documented human confirmation or per-purchase consent step. While 'authorize a maximum' and escrow/voucher limits exist (spend caps), there is no evidence of a confirmation UI, signed mandate, or per-purchase consent gate before funds move.
